audit: Full app interaction audit, Proof Layer
server: scripts/demo.py 8711 against proof_layer_lab / provider_sim_lab (restarted once at 06:16 CDT to pick up concurrent edits to app/proof.py)

counts.console_errors_unintended: render-receipt 404 at Present start; poll 404 loop after reset by another client

e2e: 1 failed, 9 passed (test_hardware_blocked_purchase_cannot_be_forced_from_the_ui: strict-mode locator race; passes alone)

defects.what: After a failed correction (409 REVISION_CONFLICT), pressing Save again sends no request and closes the sheet silently. The edit is discarded; the closed sheet reads as done.
defects.evidence: flows.json 'correction conflict + retry Save': second_submit_requests=[], sheet_open_after_second=false, db_rev unchanged

defects.what: The 4 s poll calls renderChrome(), which rewrites the nav, tab bar and viewer switch with innerHTML. Keyboard focus on any of them drops to <body> every 4 s.
defects.evidence: ux.json 'poll re-render vs keyboard focus': before='What changed', after_poll=BODY; viewer switch same

defects.what: While the X-Ray is open, every poll rebuilds the drawer. Opened <details> (sources, constraints, query plans, tests) collapse and focus is lost.
Tests tab says 'the suite caught 0 of 0'. The only mutation record is BASELINE verdict RED (1 failed, 405 passed). The UI filters it out, hiding that the mutation run never ran.
Recruiter and product Present runs finish with the Nursery camera left on Flex Stand. Undo runs only on Exit. The next manual 'Check availability' gives 'Blocked by hardware'.
defects.evidence: present.json recruiter/product mount=flex_stand after completion; engineering resets to floor_stand

defects.what: api() does not catch fetch failures. Offline, Acknowledge throws an unhandled rejection ('Failed to fetch'); no toast, no state. The poll also swallows errors, so there is no offline indicator.
defects.evidence: ux.json 'offline: poll + acknowledge': toast=null, pageerrors=['Failed to fetch' x2]

defects.what: Closing the X-Ray (Escape or close button) does not return focus to the opener; focus lands on <body>. The drawer has no focus containment; Tab walks into the hidden page behind (also at 375 px where the drawer is full screen).
defects.evidence: mobile.json desktop_focus_after_escape=BODY, tab_leaves_drawer=['Skip to briefing', 'Parent A']

defects.what: Failure lab row 'Invalid referral qualification' (held=null, 'not run: referrals are not built') is shown as red 'broken'.
Domain model 'rows (est.)' shows 0 for every table after a reset because reltuples=-1 (never analyzed) is clamped to 0. Tables hold rows (evidence_events 27, briefing_revisions 11).

defects.where: proof-layer/static/app.js:213-222 (poll swallows 404; window id from loadNight :189-194 never re-resolved)
defects.what: When another client resets the demo, an open screen polls GET brief/changes with 404 every 4 s forever and never says the night is gone.
defects.evidence: flows.json 'other client after reset': B_poll_errors 404 loop

defects.what: Toast 'Correction saved as revision 5' appears at ~0.2 s; the parent's own screen stays on Rev 4 for ~3.6 s while the client runs the dev worker subprocess before showLatest().
Boot failure message leaks a JS error: 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'find')' because loadNight ignores !me.ok.
Every Present run starts with POST /v1/render-receipts 404: a receipt for the pre-reset revision races the reset.
Targets under 44 px: viewer switch 38 px, Present 36 px, X-Ray close 35x44 at 375 px (flex shrink), Live/Data switch 38 px, proof tabs/flows 32 px, dev buttons 40 px, dev summary 36 px.
Tab-bar X-Ray is <a href='#' role='button'>; Space does not open it.
Flaky e2e: get_by_text("We didn't submit this offer.") also matches the sr-only announcer 50 ms later (strict-mode violation). Failed in the full run, passed alone.
Privacy notice says what the app never contacts, but omits that every page load requests Google Fonts (a third party sees the visitor IP).
